reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message: "Thanks, Hollis. Noted for the team: expense reports are due this Friday, Oct 16."

The simulation clock says today is Wednesday, Oct 14, so Friday is Oct 16. I couldn't confirm the deadline anywhere, though. A GBrain search found nothing about expense report due dates, and that search only matches exact keywords, so a note worded differently could have been missed. The "Friday" comes from Hollis's message alone. I didn't set any reminder or calendar entry because nobody asked for one.
